why: The maps are definitionally B's (jMap = projSeqJ, PhiMap = projSeqPhi, piMap = projSeqPi, all rfl; IsGLP = IsGoodLeftProj fieldwise), and A => B is instantiation. The only difference: A (proposition_6_4_10) has no Fredholm hypothesis on T, B keeps the text's standing assumption that T is Fredholm (unused by the exactness argument). B => A is believed derivable from B, not only true: pass to Tbar : E/ker T -> F, which is injective with range R(T) of finite codimension (R(T) + ker P = F), hence closed, so Tbar is Fredholm with P in Pi_Tbar, and exactness of E(Tbar, P) gives that of E(T, P). This needs the quotient Banach space, continuity of Tbar and the closed-range theorem for finite-codimensional ranges, none available as project lemmas; not done.
